dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #This reminds Paimon of the time you became a knight, {NICKNAME}. After fighting the dragon, we were sent off to the temples of the Four Winds...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... Why was that, again? Paimon recalls that we destroyed something inside the temples to decrease the dragon's power...

dialogues.speaker: Ann
dialogues.text: I see, so they were temples in name, but dens of evil in truth!

dialogues.speaker: Petit Chou
dialogues.text: Um, were there four temples of the Four Winds, or just one?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There were three, actually... Huh, why *were* there only three?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's been quite a while... There must've been a reason. Paimon just doesn't remember it...

dialogues.speaker: Ann
dialogues.text: Hmm. That does make sense. The trivial details of a brilliant knight's deeds wouldn't matter much, would they?
